reviews.text: Dr McCarthy is a very caring thoughtful vet who patiently listens and honestly presents the findings and possible treatments. The staff is pleasant and caring as well. The techs are kind and seem to really care for the pets they treat.. I have been going to this office for many years and have never had a bad experience. Top notch vet office !

Juniper Valley Animal Hospital is the best kept secret in all of NYC...

If you're looking for a practice that cares & love your furry babies as much as you do, than u need to visit Dr. Mike & his awesome team of vet techs.

Dr. Mike is extremely kind. He is Hands down the best veterinarian in NYC. I'm always recommending him to all my friends & neighbors.

He's caring & compassionate. He takes his time with his patients & always welcome questions from concerned parents. He gives out such an AWESOME vibe, after several visits with him I guarantee you'll think of him as family.

The team in the front are a big part of what makes this veterinary practice spectacular... shout out!!! To Jackie, she always find a way to make sure you're seen..especially when it's an emergency.

I can't stress enough the Professionalism you also get from the vet technicians, they're all a class act.
We have been taking our pets to JVAH for nearly 20 years, and we love the staff and the service they provide.

I’ve been going to Juniper for the past 12 years and I’m grateful for the care my Yorkies have received. They were always supportive and helpful whether  it was an emergency situation or a routine visit. I’m very thankful for their continued care and love for animals and their owners🐾

I’m very grateful that they were able to fit my dog in for a last-minute appointment when she really needed to be seen. I truly appreciate all the help and care they always provide. I really love this hospital and will always recommend them. Thank you so much for always being there for us! ❤️
Most compassionate vets and workers I gave ever encountered. Appreciate that when your beloved pet is reaching their end times.
Very professional and friendly staff. The establishment was very clean.
Great staff, kind doctors, clean facility!
I love bringing griffin to JVAH! He’s super happy everytime we bring him, and give a lot of great education. The facility is also very clean.
I love the care and attention the doctors and staff give my dog, Cochise.
I love the staff here and overall friendly and clean environment. They are very thorough with my dog especially when he was a puppy.

I had a sweet memory of the veterinarian some 20 years ago who cried alongside me when I had to euthanize my beloved shepherd.
Returning now with our cat Riley was another moment of caring and professionalism.
Dr Kelly read thoroughly all the labs and reports from other vets and was prepared to treat Riley. She ordered only the necessary tests and showed great knowledge in answering our questions.
Even though she wasn’t scheduled, she still took the time to call with blood results the next day.
Kudos also to the staff as well, from the vet assistant to the receptionists.
Wonderful experience!
Thank you
Christine

My initial review was made after the one bad experience I have had. Dr. Caspar saved my dog after what could have been certain death from acute pancreatitis, changed his diet set his insulin levels and he's been going strong ever since.
Very professional and kind staff and doctor. No upselling or suggestion of unnecessary procedures or prescriptions. I feel like I can trust Juniper Valley & they took great care of my cat Pew!

Juniper Valley is a place that truly cares for our pets. We have two dogs and  every time I text them with a question they are quick to respond and provide help or give us appointments when needed. I am so grateful to have a place in my neighborhood that cares. I will highly recommend this place if you need a vet for your pets. ( My daughter who has a dog comes all the way from Astoria just to see them)  Thank you to all of you for the work you are doing on a daily bases.
I am not sure how much better it could be. all of you are amazing to Dash and I. I feel so safe knowing I can count on all of you to help Dash be the best he can be.

Juniper Valley Animal Hospital staff - all staff, genuinely care about you and your pets. There dedication is only matched by their expertise in the Veteranary sciences. They go above and beyond for your pets. We called same evening with an eye issue with our dog and asked if there was any possibility of an appointment- they told us to come in the next half our; we were there until they locked up, giving us their full attention (and clipped his nails). We’ve had one follow up since and are going back this Friday. Our baby boy isn’t done healing, but he’s well on his way. I feel like our boy(s) are in the best possible hands from annual shots to emergencies. Thank you, Juniper!

Best vet ever. Brought my Samoyed there because he ripped up and ate a tennis ball unknowingly to me and it made 2 holes in his intestines. They performed an emergency surgery that lasted until 11:30 pm. He made a full recovery. The staff really care about the animals and watched him for 5 days. I’ve heard similar stories where vets charged people double and their dog was released the following day. Can’t thank them enough.
Staff very knowledgeable and caring! Excellent communication.

My cat goes here for her annuals and had a tooth extraction. I’ve been with two of the veterinarians and they’re both equally great. Reception is quick to respond; we usually communicate via text. I had an issue with my pet insurance company last year. Insurance didn’t want to pay off one of the included preventative services cause I dropped off a stool sample the day after our initial visit. They took care of it for me! It’s easy to make an appointment but I would book a month or two ahead. Thank you for taking such great care of my Lyla. 🐱
Staff was super friendly,  office was super clean, appointment was right on schedule!

Stopped by due to great reviews, tried to switch vets. They told me that their wasn’t enough staff so their not allowing new patients. Avoid and don’t waste your time.

Thanks for a response but it doesn’t change that there is a lack of service. If you can’t provide the services just advise in your website. I made a special trip due to good reviews but as if now your practice is over rated.
This place may seem like not so great; but in times of emergency; that’s where they shine. They have demonstrated that they know their stuff.
My dog Tex feels very comfortable going to Juniper Valley Animal Hospital and that is because the staff is so loving and kind to him.
Very careful, super professional, and they always respond super fast whenever you send a message

JVH Has been a great resource takings care of my 5 cats. Dr Rivera saved my boy Sammy after LIVS dropped the ball.  The staff at this hospital really care and have been really great in doing whats best for theid patients. Great Job!
JVAH is the best. Very professional and caring. I would not trust my pet with anyone else.
Lillie Rose's visit went off smoothly.

We have been so impressed by the combined courtesy, friendliness and professionalism of all the staff. We value the time Dr. Casper took to discuss Benny’s exam and growth. We are so pleased that he is off to a great start. Thank you!

I have been going to Juniper Valley Animal Hospital for probably 20 years.  Everyone is just so nice and the doctors are very thorough.  They spend 30 minutes per visit with your pet.  Through the years I have seen all the doctors.  Dr McCarthy is amazing and has operated on one of my dogs in the past.  For quite a while now, I have been seeing Dr Roemmelt for my two yorkies.  One of my yorkies has been sick since I got her, and he has really gone out of his way to find solutions to help her.  He is so knowledgeable and really works with me .  He always listens and is very thorough.  I highly recommend him and all the doctors here, and I would never take my dogs anywhere else.  I know they will always receive the best care possible at Juniper Valley Animal Hospital.
Great vets, very happy with all my cats care here.
our Cats well cared for

This practice has been going downhill for the past few years now and today  I did something I should have done a while ago.  I had an appointment for my eldest dog who probably has cognitive impairment. I was running late due to furniture being delivered much later than anticipated. I called and said I would be 15 minutes late, the receptionist Kelly tells me if I’m one minute past 15 minutes late I would have to reschedule. For a customer that has been going there for over 13 years with three dogs that was the last straw. To add insult to injury there was no one in the waiting area. They had called me called me three times to reschedule because the “doctor” had other things going on but yet they couldn’t accommodate me getting there 17 minutes late. Last year Dr. Rivera traumatized me and my poor baby after intubating him they call to say they had to remove 24 teeth! and the few they left were not even cleaned. His gums have been bleeding since the cleaning a year ago. There are plenty of capable doctors around with more compassion, my money will go to those doctors. If you’ve had a bad experience with Juniper Valley Animal Hospital, it’s not you it’s them. Find another doctor.

I highly recommend taking your pet to Juniper! They have always been very nice here, not pushy and have taken good care of Kitty when he has his checkups. We have scheduled with Dr. Roemmelt, he is great! Highly recommend!!
Great services and location!

We love JVAH.  Having moved from Middle Village to Long Island 3 years ago, we continue to return to JVAH because of the great care and compassion that is provided to Enzo by the amazing doctors and staff.  We wouldn't trust anyone else with the care of our furry boy!
Best vet in queens, we have been bringing our pets since 2000, Dr MaCarthy is amazing
Wonderful animal hospital, our dogs came here 15/16 years, and Dr. McCarthy and staff had always made our babies feel loved, and cared for, thank you!
Th best vets ever!!! Dr Kelly and Jasper are my favs ❤️ the are pricy but it’s worth every penny when it’s quality care for baby’s. I’ve been going here for over 5 years.

I’ve been taking my cats to JVAH for 18 years.  I’ve always felt secure and confident with the treatment and respect they’ve received.  The doctors and the administrative staff are friendly, polite and knowledgeable. Best of all, it feels like they have a strong affection for and understanding of the animals they treat.  I have, and will continue to, recommend their services to friends and family.
Wonderful staff & hospital 🐶 All our pets have been excellently cared for over many years 🐕

I would like to thank Dr. Rivera of JVAH for doing a great job on my dog Henry's teeth cleaning. Also thanks to the staff and technicians for having patience with me, I was more nervous then my Henry.  He is now doing great and his teeth are looking great. Thanks again.

Absolutely the best Veterinary Hospital ! Staff is Awesome!! Best Veterinarians and Veterinary Technicians! Took Great care of my Spanky and eased my fears of what was going on with him (had 2 seizures) .He is doing better now😊 …
Have been calling them for last eight months for appointments. But it just seems like they are never taking new patients.

Highly recommend! The staff is lovely, super caring, and incredibly thorough.
We’ve been taking our senior cat here for years and will continue to. Thank you Dr. Rivera for healing our cats chronic ear infections! Dr. Kelly is fantastic as well.

Extremely knowledgeable veterinarians at this practice. Office staff and vet techs are friendly and caring.
Our go-to vet, Dr Roemmelt goes above and beyond and makes me feel my dog is in the best hands.
Dr. McCarthy takes his to explain everything clearly and never make us feel rushed. The staff is always friendly and attentive, and we trust them completely with our pets’ care.

Won’t accept new patients ever. Have tried on and off since 2021 to switch to them for my cats and always turned away. Frustrating when other vets in the area are terrible and then ones that are supposedly good won’t make space even for one appointment to give a second opinion.

I’ve been bringing my cat here for the past four years, and I’ve always felt confident that they’re in excellent hands. The entire staff is consistently kind, compassionate, and supportive, and they take the time to answer questions and provide thoughtful care. It’s reassuring to know my pet is treated with care.

We had an emergency and needed to get our dog euthanized within 24 hours. Most at-home vet services were not able to service Ozone Park or South Ozone Park. Juniper was highly recommended to us but they were unable to assist as they do not readily accept new patients. If you’re having an emergency and are not already in their system, there’s a high likelihood this office would be unable to assist you.

I honestly wish I could give this place more stars. I absolutely love this vet. Their doctors are incredibly knowledgeable and are kind and sweet and their prices are affordable. The only down side is they're so popular that it's difficult to bring a new pet to their care. Juniper Valley is absolutely fantastic. They treated my cat all the way to the end of her life and they are still treating my dog. 15/10 good bois and gurls here.
JVAH- the best in Queens!!!

I found this place a few years ago and I’m honestly so grateful I did. From the front desk to the veterinarians, everyone is kind, respectful, and genuinely makes you feel taken care of—not just for yourself, but for your pets too.

Dr. Michael Roemmelt was amazing on my first visit—so gentle, approachable, and immediately put me at ease (it didn’t hurt that he has the same breed as my cat!). I’ve continued to feel that same level of trust and comfort with him at every visit. My younger cat had some digestive issues her first year, but I followed his diet recommendations and she’s been perfectly fine for the past few months.

Dr. Colleen Kelly is also fantastic. She’s incredibly kind, explains everything clearly, and makes each visit feel easy and stress-free—which I really appreciate since I try to keep things calm for my cats.

Overall, such a positive experience every time I come here. Highly recommend.
I really appreciate the time they take with us. I never feel rushed and can ask any questions and discuss any concerns I have.
Wonderful, caring doctors and excellent staff.
JVH has always been the best.  From Dr Casper to Dr McCarthy

Consistently exceptional!  Staff at the front desk are very helpful in addressing issues in relation to pet parents' concerns; they readily reach out to the doctor as needed and will be forthright if the doctor in whom you are interested is not available at the time, etc.  They also know how to relay your questions correctly to the doctors, which I think, wouldn't always be that easy.   I appreciate this very much.

I have preferences for specific doctors over others, but that is my personal opinion.  The doctors whom I reach for to care for my pets are professional and knowledgeable, but very caring, too.  I have confidence in the doctors whom I see there for my pets.
The staff is professional, explain all details, and handle your pets with care.    No service is provided without the owners consent.
Such a clean and friendly facility and Dr. Mike is the best
Extremely kind, knowledgeable, and compassionate staff.

Quite the hidden gem. Brought my dog in and was treated well by everyone. Dr Kelly was attentive and had a great bedside manner. All procedures were explained in depth. The surprisingly the cost was reasonable. My and the fur babies will definitely be back.

My dog went in for an ear infection check up, but the vet was able to give him his annual shot and his fecal exam only one day, which is great. Also, my dog has insurance and the lovely front desk. Ladies are able to submit the claims for you, which is such a time saver. Also making an appointment with them is such a breeze. I just txt them. Thank you!
The veterinarian here actually saved my dog’s life. She needs to be checked a couple of times a year and she’s on maintenance meds and doing well.

I would like to sincerely thank Dr. Kelly for her professionalism, patience, and genuine care. When Shirley was unwell, it was a very stressful time for us as pet owners, and Dr. Kelly was incredibly attentive throughout the process. She took the time to clearly explain test results and treatment options, and most importantly, she continued to follow up on Shirley’s condition, which made us feel truly supported and reassured.
I would also like to thank the front desk staff — they were all very kind, patient, and caring. They were friendly to Shirley and always helpful with communication, scheduling, and follow-ups, making the entire experience much smoother during an anxious time.
We are very grateful for the entire team’s dedication and compassion. It truly means a lot to know our dog is in such capable and caring hands.
All the Drs here are great and they obviously care about our fur babies.
didnt help my boyfriends cat at all what a waste of money

Veterinarian Collen Kelly is superb and very wonderful and so is the supporting staff at Juniper Valley Animal Hospital. It is a pleasure to be under their care for your loving pets. Always  Ken and Irene.
Very attentive. They have a tough job and they do the best they can to care of your family member.
they were very respectful and good with my family when we had to put down my childhood dog earlier this year. we really appreciated the memorial package they sent a couple weeks after!
Always professional and compassionate

When my cat suddenly became very ill in June, Dr. Rivera and the team at Juniper Animal Hospital provided prompt and attentive care. The hospital saw her right away, which was a huge help during a stressful moment.

Given my cat’s condition, we were in and out of the hospital often - even spending several nights in supportive care. Dr. Rivera developed a thoughtful treatment plan that stabilized her and kept her comfortable, giving me five more months with her that I’ll always be grateful for.

Those months were emotionally difficult, but Dr. Rivera’s calm presence and patience made a difference. He took time to explain things clearly and offered reassurance when I felt overwhelmed. I couldn’t have asked for a better doctor to guide me through such a delicate time.

I've been bringing my first two cats here since 2007. Every vet they've seen has been wonderful. Even since moving to NJ, I still bring my nearly 19 year old to Queens because the reason she's made it this far is because of the doctors here. The culture and approach to care is one of taking into consideration all facets of an animal's circumstances, not simply suggesting what's standard. That's how a cat gets to be nearly 19 and still doing great after cancer twice, losing all but three teeth, hyperthyroid, and losing a kidney.

Appointments are readily available in a reasonable amount of time, and they've taken my cats in same day a few times for emergencies (without charging an emergency surcharge, at least at the time). Being open on the weekends and having daily tech hours for things like blood draws are above and beyond for a lot of vet offices too, which I didn't realize until I've had to go without in NJ.

Truly cannot recommend this hospital enough.

Vets who are kind, well trained and thorough. Front desk people who are personable. Clean waiting room with coffee and water for the humans. Clean and modern exam rooms. Most importantly, every one seems to love dogs and cats.

This is the Best veterinary office !
Staff are friendly, office is clean and welcoming. Best pet care service and easy and quick appointments. I love Juniper Valley hospital!
Great, modern facility, Veterinarians,and staff.  Even have a full dog scale at the entrance if all you want is keeping tabs on your dogs weight. Parking and convenient.

I brought my cat Shaina to this place and was seen by the INCOMPETANT DR COLLEEN KELLY…..well my baby had a mass in her right cheek so instead of taking an X-ray, she wanted me to wait 3 weeks for a biopsy!! The mass was rapidly growing so I couldn’t wait 3 Weeks to find out what AMC in Manhattan found out with a simple X-RAY ! I ultimately had to put my baby down right then and there as her face was distorted within a day or two. THANK GOD for AMC they made my baby comfortable and we were able to spend as much time with her as we wanted before having to say goodbye💔

This is the best veterinary clinic I’ve ever been to! My cat is 14.5 years old and has some chronic conditions. I’ve had a wonderful experience with Juniper Valley’s customer service and Dr. Roemmelt. It can be quite stressful taking care of a senior pet you love so much, but Dr. Roemmelt always gives professional advice whenever I have questions. I’m so grateful for all the help and care we’ve received!

I called this place twice, within one year apart from each call and both times I have been told that they are not taking in new patients.
The first time I Called was last year June 2024, my dog was attacked by another dog and this was relatively closer and when I called the receptionist was rude and said they were not taking in new patients and that they can’t give prices over the phone.
The second time I called was a week ago, and this time I didn’t even get a person to answer the phone, instead I was redirected to a text message and got the same thing, they’re not taking new patients.

Well, in that case I think there should be a big sign on the website and in maps saying that THEY ARE NOT TAKING NEW PATIENTS. Instead of taking pride in being a good clinic and can’t even provide services.
I love the customer service, they are quick to respond via text. Great Vet quality, it is unmatched.
Staff is amazing and we are always treated as if we are their own family

This vet and animal hospital has gone down hill. The prices are sky high. You wait on the phone for 20 minutes at a time with no one getting back to you. When you do get someone on the phone they tell you there are only 2 people answering phones. You pay thousands of dollars and get no service in return. So disappointed.

I recently transferred my pet to Juniper Valley Hospital, and I wish I had done so sooner. My dog has been treated by Dr. Kelly and Dr. Casper during separate visits, and I cannot express enough positive remarks about both veterinarians. Their expertise, attentiveness, and caring demeanor are truly commendable, making the experience exceptional. The professionalism of this facility sets a high standard for veterinary care. Additionally, the office is impressively clean and beautifully designed. I also want to highlight the affordability of their services; I have never encountered such reasonable prices while owning a dog. The value provided is extraordinary, ensuring that your beloved pet is in excellent hands. I wholeheartedly recommend Juniper Valley Hospital!
The staff are great ! They took care of my pet buster with care !
The best care for my puppy, I am very happy because I have the best service for my baby.

JVAH is great. They aren't expensive. The facility has been renovated with state of the art equipment.  Saw Dr. Kelly for my cats and she is so nice. I've had to deal with rude doctors before (not at JVAH)  and it's upsetting when you're only asking questions because you're worried about your babies. She was very professional and courteous.
JVAH is always the most welcoming place for humans as well as our animal companions.  Dr. McCarthy and his team make certain that they pursue the best outcomes.
Excellent care. Dr Casper is wonderful. Very knowledgeable and kind. You can see she really cares about her patients!
Im new costumer i try to call to make appointment they put me on hold for hours they I try to call again and I told them I can’t hold any more and she was so rude I don’t recommend this place

juniper valley was recommended to us, and honestly i'm so glad we gave it a try. i own two bulldogs and it love that i can trust juniper with both of my babies! all the staff is very friendly and helpful. we appreciate you all'

I’ve been bringing my cats to Juniper Valley for their care, and I truly trust this place with their wellness. While it can be a bit pricey, the level of care is outstanding and absolutely worth it.
Dr. Casper, Dr. Kelly, and Dr. Rivera are all incredibly attentive and compassionate with my pets. I highly recommend Juniper Valley to anyone looking for exceptional veterinary care.

The entire staff is great! The receptionists  are friendly and helpful. The Vet assistants have all been kind and caring. All the Veterinarians that have treated Happy Gracie  have been excellent. I’m especially pleased with how Dr Roemmelt has treated and cared for Happy. He has been very thorough with Happy’s health issues. I know she’s in great hands. He makes sure that all questions are answered and explains everything in detail.
He is a doctor that has the qualities of what a concerned pet parent needs. He’s kind and compassionate and very professional.
It’s evident that he truly loves his pet patients and wants the best for them.
I am very satisfied and so grateful for all he’s done and continues to do. Thank you Juniper Valley Animal Hospital!
Such a great vet, so patient, kind and detailed. see you soon!
Great place with great people who really care about the pets

We'd like to share our appreciation for the care Yuki has received at Juniper Valley Animal Hospital. Dr. Kelly is very attentive, takes the time to answer all our questions, and makes sure everything runs smoothly for Yuki.

Ms. Mitchell is caring and compassionate, and the front desk staff are welcoming and efficient.

Thank you all for the wonderful care and service.

The best animal hospital in Queens. Very friendly and patient staff, the Dr’s genuinely care about your pet. Dr. Casper is one of their best vets there along with Dr. McCarthy.  I highly recommend bringing your fur baby to JVAH.
Excellent animal hospital.
I highly recommend them. They really take care of your pet and treat them as family. I only wish they can have their own 24 hour emergency service.
I am still assessing this Veteinarian.  Good results thus far.  The same vet stayed with my dog. Some parking available.

Support staff is conscientious and knowledgeable. Dr. Mike exceeds all expectations of Veterinary Medicine and bedside manner. Our experience with Juniper Valley Animal Hospital has been first rate and it’s a pleasure to write a genuine review.
Dr. Mike and the staff were super friendly and answered any questions or concerns that we had. They made our first visit a great experience.

I’ve been bringing my dog Misha to Dr. Kristina Casper for several years now, and I can confidently say she is one of the best veterinarians we’ve ever had the pleasure of working with. Her professionalism, compassion, and deep understanding of animals are truly exceptional.

I want to sincerely thank the clinic for having such a gem on their team — it’s doctors like Dr. Casper who are the true foundation of quality veterinary care. We’re so grateful for everything she has done for Misha over the years.
this animal hospital is amazing! i trust leaving my baby dog  in his hands, they are very friendly .My dog had a surgery and the day after they call me to know if my dog is doing ok.

Always very grateful to everyone at JVAH for taking such good care of our babies. Many thanks for getting Toby in to see Dr. Casper quickly. Dr. Casper was great- very knowledgeable, caring and patient. Thank you so much!

This is the best facility for your fur baby. The Vets, assistants and products are all amazing, they genuinely love your babies and you. I have been taking my Star there for years and I trust no one else with her. HIGHLY RECOMMEND.
The whole staff is amazing.
Extremely caring and knowledgeable nurses, doctors and staff. Pet care on another level
Super attentive and compasionate. My dog liked going. They helped him have a long, healthy, and happy life. I will.ne bringing my new pup as well.
They are great at Juniper, I wouldn’t take my pets anywhere else.
Amazing doctors, wonderful staff, very responsive always!

You exceeded my expectations so u couldn't have done anything better!
Everyone was a delight!! Thank u!
The staff and doctor are awesome.
Excellent doctors and care for my frenchie. The clinic is beautiful and clean. The front desk staff is friendly and helpful!
Wonderful staff and doctors. Everyone is friendly and they care about my little fur baby.

We love Juniper Valley. Our fur babies are very well taken care of by the team. They make it very easy to contact them for appointments, emergency visits, and medicine refills. Dr. Kelly and Dr. Rivera are very gentle with our cats and thorough with their examinations and explanations.
Love this place for my bby girl. Been here twice and love the way the treat her and attend her. Highly recommended to all the other pet owners. Had an emergency and they attended me right away.
Dr. Roemmelt is very friendly and was able to calm the nerves of my cat during her first ever check up. Very reasonable prices. I will come back here

From the Meyers Family.
Staff is SUPER friendly and makes you feel welcomed. Tech assistance was super friendly . Went over medication until I understood how to administer.
Dr. McCarthy AS ALWAYS is the best. Never makes you feel rushed. Addresses all my questions. Looks for new solutions to conquer the issue.  His love for animals and his job shows thru his work. Truly one of a kind. Thank you Dr McCarthy.
We had the best experience here! Friendly doctors and staff, VERY clean, honest & transparent. So glad we found this vet!
I loved everything and the patience they had with my cat and they take their time to explain everything related to what they will do with your pet.

Amazing staff and environment. Everyone here is super friendly, Dr McCarthy and Dr Kelly are very professional. Price is fair and reasonable compared to other animal hospitals.
There was some issues with my dogs insurance and medications but the lovely front desk receptionists were able to help me out. I'm so glad I discovered this place. My dog's been going here since a puppy and we will continue coming here in the future!

love the staff here! they take great care of my dog and always listening to my concerns. they’re also very responsive through text! thanks for the great service!
The staff here are very knowledgeable and clearly care about the animals greatly. We've brought our pets here for a decade and continue to do so.

The best! It took me several failed attempts at finding a good vet. Had terrible experiences with two or three other animal hospitals in the area before JVAH was suggested to me. I adore Dr. Casper but am sure the other vets are equally capable, friendly and caring. Great facility - bright, modern and comfortable. My dogs don’t mind going there, which is always a good sign since most vets dogs will pull back not wanting to walk in. Not here - my pups just know they’ll be cared for so well. And their prices aren’t bad. Middle of the road - no over- or unnecessary charges. They’re very honest what your pet actually needs and talks through options. Plus the front desk and tech staff also reflect this welcoming environment. Highly recommend!
Both receptionists have the worst attitude. And they never picked up the phone.
It’s comforting to know that there is such a caring Vet so close to us. Whenever we call or text with a question or concern, we ALWAYS receive a timely response from the doctor or staff.
The best of the best .
Juniper is the best, I know if I take my pets there they will do their absolute best. I trust them 100%

my dog has been coming here for over a year now and she always has a great time (lots of praises from the friendly staff). They answer quickly and the doctors are very knowledgeable, patient, and offer options so that you can make the best decision for your pet. Thank you for taking care of my dog 💜 …
The doctors are very knowledgeable as well as kind to me and my cat.  I leave my appointment knowing the staff took great care of my cat and genuinely care about her health and happiness.  Love JVAH!
Juniper Valley Animal Hospital knows how to treat our adorable pets.   Wonderful veterinarian & staffs that you can trust with your pet.
Very patient and caring staff and doctors. My dog got spayed there and it was a great experience. They are great at communicating and responding to any questions and concerns.

Juniper Valley is the only place i’ll trust with my puppy! Really appreciate the convenience of texting and they are always prompt to reply to my appointment requests and urgent care-related questions. They have squeezed me in same day/next day many times. We love Dr. Kristina Casper and Dr. Colleen Kelly, and the front desk staff is the best.
Great place for our fur babies. Amazing front staff and Dr. Kelly did a very thereal examination. Recommend JVAH 💯 …

I love that I can text JVAH and they always respond.  I love that they always offer more than one way of going about treating whatever is wrong with your pet based on the owners' financial limitations and comfort level of invasiveness.  One minor thing was that I didn't get a call on the day one of the doctors said he would call back, so I had to reach out.  When you're anxious about your pet, that can be unnerving.

The staff is warm and responsive. The Dr took the time to make sure I understood everything we discussed. I've been able to get same day appts. The facility is clean. There's a small parking lot  and free street parking.
I called to make an appointment, and they said no availability for 4-6 weeks and to try and find somewhere else.
The entire staff is so kind and helpful! We appreciate their support so much!

i would give less than one star if i could. a friend recently took their beloved kitty cat to this establishment due to a hip fracture and this place told her that they WOULD NOT treat her cat UNLESS she paid $5k  to keep her there overnight and another $12K to treat the fracture or else she would die. they refused to give her any pain medication after she told them she could not afford that obscene amount of money. they charged her $700 for a consultation that lasted roughly 10 minutes and it was filled with them reinforcing the wrongful fact she was going to die. this is disgusting behavior and anyone who plans to do business with this place in the future should beware of the fear mongering and excessive charges that this place allows.

Last Friday at 7:30 pm, Good Samaritans brought in a kitten hit by a car. She was limp, weak, covered in blood, and unable to move. Cats are small, and cars are big, so her injuries were severe. These folks didn’t know her owner or if she was a stray, but they wanted to help. We treat all hit-by-car cases as emergencies, regardless of the pet’s status, so we provided immediate care.

Within 10 minutes, our doctor examined the cat, performed diagnostics, and started life-saving treatment. She was in shock, so we placed an IV catheter, administered fluids, started heat support and provided oxygen. She also received pain relief(morphine) for her broken bones.

After stabilizing her medically, we searched for her owner. She had a worn pink collar but no ID tags. A scan revealed she was microchipped, but the chip wasn’t registered to any person. Fortunately, the chip was registered to the rescue group that placed her with a family and after a few calls, we located the family and informed them about the situation. It was past 8 pm, which is our facility’s closing time. The doctor in charge spoke to the family, letting them know her status, injuries, and recommended transferring her to a facility with overnight care as she still needed critical medical treatment and pain control. Our team waited for her family to arrive and transfer her. Once there, they visited her, discussed her status, diagnostics, and our doctor recommended three overnight facilities for her treatment and follow-up surgery. The family decided to take her to an emergency facility not recommended by us that evening. It was a little after 9:30 pm when she left our hospital for the family’s chosen ER

At the chosen ER, the attending doctor examined her and found her still in shock with possible internal bleeding and pale gums. They recommended continued monitoring, fluid therapy, and pain medications in the ICU overnight. Outpatient treatment for pain control was also discussed. Post-emergency care for possible surgery was likely discussed.

After all options were presented, her family declined all, including pain medications, and chose to take her home.

To be clear, the events described—spending only 5 minutes with a doctor, receiving an ICU care estimate of $5,000, a surgery estimate of $12,000, and a lack of pain control—occurred at the ER her family chose, not with us. Our team, including the doctor, spent a large amount of time with the family, and since we do not offer the intense overnight care she needed, nor perform the complex orthopedic surgery she would need, we would not have provided estimates for these services. We did provide immediate emergency stabilization and provide pain relief for her and we stand firmly by these actions. We ask you to remove this inaccurate and inappropriate review of our hospital at this time. If you have any questions or need further clarification about the care she received while with us that evening, please don’t hesitate to contact us anytime.

Dr. McCarthy
